seo_title: Click2View Asia Case Study: Reporting Time Saved | SOMIN
description: Click2View Asia used SOMIN's Brand Tracker and SODA to cut monthly client reporting from 9 hours to 1 and comprehensive competitor analysis from 18 hours to 3.
eyebrow: Agency case study · Content marketing · APAC
h1: Click2View Asia cut monthly reporting from 9 hours to 1 with SOMIN
lede: Click2View Asia, a content marketing agency working across Asia-Pacific, runs its competitor monitoring and client reporting on SOMIN. With Brand Tracker and the SODA analytics assistant, monthly reporting fell from 9 hours to 1 and comprehensive competitive analysis from 18 hours to 3, freeing senior time for consultation.
meta_line: A SOMIN agency customer story · Asia-Pacific · Content marketing

challenge.title: Click2View Asia's strategist hours went on collating data
challenge.body: Click2View Asia builds editorial-quality brand content programmes for global brands and APAC challengers, with consultative strategy at the core of its offer. Monthly client reporting, competitive landscape audits and content strategy groundwork were consuming dozens of hours every cycle, much of it spent collating data from disparate sources across platforms and clients. The agency wanted to upscale its consultative offering, but needed that time back first.

approach.title: Brand Tracker and SODA as the agency's reporting layer
points: Made SOMIN the competitive-intelligence and reporting infrastructure behind the agency's consulting work.
Brand Tracker handles the cross-client competitor monitoring that would otherwise need multiple analysts.
SODA, SOMIN's analytics assistant, writes plain-language narrative summaries of category performance that strategists used to write longhand.
Content Library and Perspective Studies complete the set of SOMIN modules the agency uses.
The hours reclaimed from reporting and competitor audits feed back into senior consultation.

findings_title: 80–90% less time on Click2View's repeating workstreams

findings.title: Monthly reporting down from 9 hours to 1
findings.body: Monthly client reporting now takes 1 hour instead of 9, an 89% time reduction. A mini competitive analysis also fell from 9 hours to 1.

findings.title: Competitive deep dives in 3 hours, not 18
findings.body: Comprehensive competitive landscape work, the kind that anchors a category strategy, is now a 3-hour exercise instead of an 18-hour one. Content strategy groundwork fell from 14 hours to 2.

findings.title: One person per workstream instead of two
findings.body: Headcount per workstream dropped from 2 people to 1. Across the core repeating workstreams, time on task fell by 80–90%, with corresponding cost savings.

delivered.title: Four SOMIN modules behind Click2View's client work
points: Brand Tracker for cross-client competitor monitoring
SODA, the analytics assistant, for plain-language narrative summaries of category performance
Content Library and Perspective Studies alongside them in the same workflow
Monthly client reports in 1 hour and comprehensive competitive analyses in 3
A SOMIN subscription the agency has extended for an additional engagement window

quote.text: SOMIN and SODA are very helpful solutions that take the legwork out of getting data from disparate sources across clients and platforms

outcome.title: Click2View's reclaimed hours feed upsell and new business
outcome.body: The reclaimed time goes back into senior consultation, so the agency can take on more strategic work, not just more execution work. Click2View projects a 100–400% new-business uplift and a 100–200% upsell to existing clients, and has extended its SOMIN subscription for an additional engagement window.

faq.q: How much time did Click2View Asia save with SOMIN?
faq.a: Monthly client reporting fell from 9 hours to 1 (an 89% reduction), a mini competitive analysis from 9 hours to 1, a comprehensive competitive analysis from 18 hours to 3, and content strategy groundwork from 14 hours to 2.

faq.q: Which SOMIN modules does Click2View Asia use?
faq.a: Brand Tracker, SODA (SOMIN's analytics assistant), Content Library and Perspective Studies. Brand Tracker handles cross-client competitor monitoring, and SODA writes plain-language summaries of category performance.

faq.q: What business impact does Click2View Asia expect?
faq.a: The agency projects a 100–400% new-business uplift and a 100–200% upsell to existing clients, driven by the bandwidth to take on more strategic work. Headcount per workstream also fell from 2 people to 1.
